Listen to the original and hear         the difference! I first typed over the notes (bass + lead) from a Music         Assembler example tune. Not using the ugly percussion track. The         chords are typed over from a Midi file called Biker. (Lazy me eh?!).         Maybe this will not be necessary in future because there is a Midi to         Mod program and buddy Roland Hermans has made a Mod to Sid program.         I'm not quite happy with this tune because of the weak 2 notes         arpeggio part (from 1:14 to 1:50). I made the volume of this arpeggio         part a bit softer so it becomes a bit less annoying. Maybe I will         improve this tune sometime. Same presets used as in Rolfie Title         Remix. Typing over the notes took some amount of time (I always work         slowly!). I used too many sequences in the 2nd track (it can only         handle 128). So Roland Hermans "packed" several sequences into only a         few so the player can handle them. This is the 2nd tune for mainly         Polish based group Axelerate. Tune is played at CIA 1 Timer A (PAL)         because we wanted another speed than a normal one. Tune has nice         ending, don't you agree? Hope you like it!" (JW)

TITLE: Advanced Space Battle
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "I went into this project wanting to write a "classic" SID that people         want to listen to frequently perhaps even like a good 80s game SID.         Soon I noticed I had too few good ideas myself so I used some         "borrowed" music in this one in true Rob Hubbard style (he also covered         a lot as you know). So some of other composer's music was the basis of         some tunes varied with own ideas and combinations of these 2. Of course         Roland Hermans (Neo) helped me with the technical bits." (JW)(#1)   NAME: Intro TuneCOMMENT: "The short intro jingle still went some work in it being quite complex.         The end sounds particularly well with that kick sound attached to the         bass." (JW)(#2)   NAME: The War Begins  TITLE: Spybreak! [from Decksandrumsandrockandroll] (1:16-2:33) ARTIST: PropellerheadsCOMMENT: "As you can hear in The War Begins I like the Matt Gray style. It's         simple to do and still sounds great. The combination with the Matrix         tune works well I think. Also I listened to a lot of hard rock/heavy         metal music to get inspired. A lot of what Matt Gray did can be         identified with this style. Using double bass plus MG drums is a good         combination plus after that a ring modulation lead sounds nice." (JW)(#3)   NAME: Massive AttackCOMMENT: "Massive Attack begins with 2 tracks shooting SFX from the game         Dominator. Then a Star Wars alike film tune. The piece after that the         Jon Dunn's Robocop lead instrument fits and sounds so well! Some funny         kicks and snares in different volumes. The last piece is very short 'n         simple and still sounds good. Only a few sequences used. About 4 if I         remember well." (JW)(#4)   NAME: Arduous BattleCOMMENT: "Arduous Battle is completely done by me. In a lot of places the bass         notes are harder on the beat. In this I made a 64 version of a tune I         composed on the Amiga with Protracker which was called Freedom. What I         really like about this tune is the end part which was also first         composed on the Amiga." (JW)(#5)   NAME: The Tragic OneCOMMENT: "Sniff sniff! A very melancholic beginning. Then some sort of Philip         Glass stuff which ends with an attempt to do something similar to         Hubbard's Knucklebusters tune #2 ending." (JW)(#6)   NAME: Final Conquest  TITLE: Captain Future [from cartoon series Captain Future] (2:59-5:33) ARTIST: Christian BruhnCOMMENT: "Another fine tune beginning to get your attention immediately! A bit         filmesque start. Then a very nice Captain Future cover with some         fantastic stretched arpeggios in it. The break in this part is my         friend Roland's favourite (You know him from the PSID64 program). And         the last part is composed by myself using some Galway  Rambo tune #5         instruments which I made a bit harder volume wise. Oh yes the         instrument of the arpeggios is an enhanced version of Jason Brooke's         Bismarck arp. preset." (JW)(#7)   NAME: Space ExplorerCOMMENT: "Space Explorer has a very mysterious intro. As you can hear Philip         Glass is one of my favourite composers. Jam jam! Sounds very nice! The         ending uses a technique I use whenever it suits: divide the notes over         2 tracks and play them slightly over eachother. Always sounds very         good!" (JW)(#8)   NAME: Worm Hole in 1COMMENT: "I'm very pleased with the first part of this one. Cool and agressive!         Than Matt Gray meets Rob Hubbard! Technically one of the best I've         written so far. Wooo! Wicked part from 2:02! Speed change in music         player is handy! Bit boring end of 1st part. I got tired of writing for         ASB. End part has it's moments. Robocop lead keeps ruling!" (JW)

TITLE: All (B)ears
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: (#1)  TITLE: Passacaglia ARTIST: <?>COMMENT: "A partial cover of a music which was one of the demo tunes in the         Amiga music program Deluxe Music Construction Set. Bass resembles a         bit the first part of House of the Rising Sun by The Animals when the         singing starts. Used as jiffy sound on my 1st music colly!" (JW)(#2)  TITLE: Yogi Bear Song ARTIST: Hoyt Stoddard Curtin (music), William Hanna & Joseph Barbera (lyrics)COMMENT: "From the animated TV series "Yogi Bear" composed in 1960. This was         harder to convert than I expected. I asked some acquaintances to help         me out but they couldn't. So I did it myself and there are no off key         notes in this! Presets are from Parasol Stars tunes. An mp3 was the         example for this. Used as Title tune of my 1st music colly!" (JW)

TITLE: All (B)ears Turn Disk
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "Own composed in true JW style! To get going making midi files I'm         making a midi cover of this. I'd better make those chords notes         slower (I want to go towards making music for a band). Instead of         using slides I used Dane's technique (in Whistle song): a length 1         note for some lead notes. Used as Turn disk music in my 1st music         colly." (JW)

TITLE: Arabian Nights
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "Demo containing this tune had a nice "gadget" enclosed. The drive led         reacted on 1 of the tracks. (Ofcourse coded by Roland Hermans). I only         just came up with the title of this song after Roland changed         something in the presets (instruments) which gave it an Arabian touch.         Ok I think. Composed on piano." (JW)

TITLE: Archimedes' Dial
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven & R. Hermans
STILENTRY: TITLE: The Raiders March [from all the Indiana Jones movies] ARTIST: John Williams

TITLE: As de sterre dao baove straole
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: TITLE: As de sterre dao baove straole ARTIST: Arthur "Thuur" Luxembourg (music), Frans Boermans (lyrics)COMMENT: "The demo in which this sound was spread contained the full lyrics of         the song written in South Dutch dialect. This tune consists of a         double lead to get a sort of echo effect. The reason why I made this         song: In the south of Holland we celibrate Carnival each year around         the end of February and because I live in a provence of Southern         Holland called Limburg I decided to make one of the best Carnival         songs on the C64! During Carnival everyone dresses up in some strange         costume and goes into pubs to party and of course drink a lot of beer.         The title of the song translated into English is: When the stars are         shining up there. Written in waltz tempo. Hope you like it." (JW)

TITLE: Beast III Title
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: TITLE: press fire [from the Amiga game Shadow of the Beast III] ARTIST: Tim WrightCOMMENT: "Of course I had to squeeze the Amiga 4 tracks in to C64's 3. But the         tune uses 2 tracks for the part which isn't the lead or bass. How do         you call that part anyway? (backing?) While going through old Amiga         500 games with buddy Roland (we were looking through because we are         planning a C64 demo consisting converted Amiga pics in FLI-Interlace)         we stumbled upon this tune. I like it very much so I tried if I could         rip it with my Datel Electronics' Amiga Action Replay MK III. I froze         the game and typed in tracker. And golly yes! The cartridge found the         tune and I saved it to disc and loaded it in my Protracker soundtool.         Together with Roland I converted it. (He works much quicker than me).         We are planning to do more conversions. After this conversion Roland         made a program to convert from MOD to SID, right into my player as         I said in Action Biker Remix STIL text. But now it even converts         arpeggios! The presets are: bass from Psycho Pigs UXB. Flute resembles         Amiga lead sample instrument but has a little waveform 41 tick at         the beginning and is made by Roland. Other preset is from Henning         Rokling's Henning_Rokling-02.sid which is used in demo Wild At Heart.         We first made an arpeggio sound consisting of two different c notes         but it didn't work out well. In beginning of the tune you can hear a         build up of decay and sustain in this preset. To get this effect we         had to make 4 presets just changing the decay and sustain from 2 to 8.         The wave on effects on bass and Rokling preset make it sound ok on         C64. Often this effect is used to substitute normal hi hat sounds.         This ditty is one of my favourite tunes!" (JW)

TITLE: Because I Got High
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Because I Got High ARTIST: AfromanCOMMENT: "Before I saw the movie Jay & Silent Bob Strike back (this         zax was the end music of the hilarious film) I wanted to         make a cover of this afrolicious tune! It's probably the         only tune they made which is cool. This C64 version is         a bit faster, probably in an other key and is fast composed.         The arpeggio lead was taken from my Space Harrier Remix.         Respect!" (JW)

TITLE: Blackadder Theme
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Blackadder [from the TV series] ARTIST: Howard GoodallCOMMENT: "The one that drove JW insane was Blackadder Theme. I was looking and         looking for bass notes but never found any that sounded good! So I         decided to let them out and use 2 voices for the lead. The idea to         make this mini tune was that I coincidentally found a nice midi file         on the net from which I only used the background. Preset of this is         taken from Demon's Aural Manouvers II. I listened to the original TV         theme on the BBC and was surprised to find out that I liked this         version more than the original!" (JW)

TITLE: Bladerunner Techno
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Blade Runner (End Titles) [from the movie] ARTIST: VangelisCOMMENT: "This zax covers the techno version by Tyrell Bros. The kick and bass         sound much better on a real C64. Finding the fast notes needed some         time until I found out the notes were also in the chords. Kick sound         was taken from a tune by Sad rest done by me and Roland. A midi tune         helped me also." (JW)

TITLE: Dream Away
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven

TITLE: Duncan
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Duncan [from Pubs, Trucks and Plains] ARTIST: Slim DustyCOMMENT: "Unkle K asked me to cover this tune for Reset #05 Intro so I made a quick         rendition. I must say I like this one the most of all Dusty's tracks." (JW)

TITLE: Especially for Reinier
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Stille Nacht! Heilige Nacht! ARTIST: Joseph Mohr (lyrics), Franz Xaver Gruber (music)COMMENT: "This little zax was hence the name especially made for a man I know         from my home village who collects all existing versions of the Silent         Night tune. This tune was used in a Covenant demo for the X-mas         competition 2003." (JW)

TITLE: Forester
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "Game was made (like Tough Guys) by Ramon (BB) van de Laar. And it's         about a forester who has to paint the brown leaves green again         avoiding EVIL forest animals. It was a real pain in the ass to play         but was awarded as one of the best games in '92.         My pally Roland Hermans (ex-Einstein/RGJ/Smidas from ATG (Actual         Trading Generation) always helped me with the technical bits of C64         music like players and presets etc. Some presets throughout this game         music are from Johannes Bjerregaard's Flimbo's Quest. There's one I         used as lead, bass and as arpeggio (chords)." (JW)(#1)COMMENT: "This is the congratulations tune consisting a Follin like melody row         of fast notes made by Roland Hermans. The filter lead in the         beginning is from Jeroen Tel's Myth tune #3. As you can hear I very         much like to leave the bass away at the end of zaxes to get a nice         "echo" effect." (JW)(#2)COMMENT: "This level tune #1, a 2-voice zax made in a simple march tempo. The         other track was used as sound-fx track. I thought about putting in a         3rd optional drum track or extra lead track but this was thought to be         not necessary." (JW)(#3)COMMENT: "This is the second level zax, also 2-voiced. Bit more cheerful than         the 1st level zax. Bits of the melody popped into my mind when I was         cycling home from school." (JW)(#4)  TITLE: Canon in D major ARTIST: Johann PachelbelCOMMENT: "I used a Tim Follin bass from Psycho Pigs UXB tune #1. The harmonica         is from Follin's Black Lamp, Tune #1." (JW)(#5)COMMENT: "This is the game over tune. First made in Dutch USA team's Music         Assembler. I made this tune not knowing what it would become. But it         fits its purpose very nicely I think." (JW)(#6)COMMENT: "This is the high score tune. Before Forester this sound was published         (slightly different from this one) as "Ode to Junior". Junior was a         cat that we had at my elderly home. Was, because he's now in cat's         heaven. Tune was made in a period I didn't know how to make use of         arpeggio's (chord substitutes). It's still ok, I guess." (JW)(#7)COMMENT: "This is the bonus level tune. It's made a bit faster than the level         tunes to get that hectic feel. Funny is the extreme fast part starting         from (1:41) which may make the game even more difficult to play if you         let yourself be influenced by the sound." (JW)(#8)  TITLE: Kwik Snax, Tune #6 ARTIST: Robert WestgateCOMMENT: "This is the end of level zax. Without knowing I somewhat copied tune         #6 from Codemasters' Kwik Snax. I used 2 tracks for the lead to get         that sort of echo stuff in." (JW)

TITLE: Gameboy Tetris High Score
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: High Score [from the Game Boy game Tetris] ARTIST: Hirokazu Tanaka (Hip)COMMENT: "This is 1 of my 2 all time Game Boy favorites, the 1st is of course         Super Mario Land. This zax has the same structure as Blackadder Theme         but the lead in Blackadder is more fluty. The midi tune I found on the         net had some faults in it. But they were soon ironed out by me." (JW)

TITLE: Glassworks Opening/Closing
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Opening/Closing [from Glassworks] ARTIST: Philip GlassCOMMENT: "This is my 2nd Glass cover and there will follow more. This is         converted from a midi file I found on the net. All presets are the         same but the bass preset is a bit softer. This preset is from         Jonathan Dunn's Robocop. Very nice pulse thingy in it. The lead from         1:55 is done by me." (JW)

TITLE: Gray Runner
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Blade Runner (End Titles) [from the movie] ARTIST: VangelisCOMMENT: "This zax is a Matt Gray alike version of Bladerunner end         titles, hence the name. It was used in one of JSL's entries         for the gfx competition on Vision 2003. I thought a nice         picture needs a nice sound. Pity the music was not played         during the gfx compo. This was changed in comparison with         last year's party. Bass preset is from a Boogaloo sound,         Matt Gray drums were surprisingly not taken from one of         his sounds but from a Fanta tune, lead done by Roland. First         use of ring modulation of this kind in a tune by me!" (JW)

TITLE: Gryzor Title Revisited
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven & R. Hermans
STILENTRY: TITLE: Sandinista (Ending) [from the arcade game Contra] ARTIST: Kazuki Muraoka

TITLE: Honey Bee
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven & R. Hermans
STILENTRY: (#3)  TITLE: Tiroler Holzhacker Buab'n (op. 356) ARTIST: Joseph Franz WagnerCOMMENT: "First part was written for Curly Squirrel game which never saw the         light of day." (JW)

TITLE: Infinity
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: TITLE: Infinity [from Infinity] ARTIST: Guru JoshCOMMENT: "If I had the knowledge I now have when I made this piece I certainly         would have put in some chords and combined the drums and bass in one         track like Moz(IC)Art did (the best version on the C64). Reyn         Ouwehand's version also has its moments. Though I think my version has         the most resembling saxophone sound on this compy." (JW)

TITLE: Koyaanisqatsi
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: TITLE: Koyaanisqatsi [from the movie] ARTIST: Philip GlassCOMMENT: "Glass' own style is called "minimalistic music". I got the music on         tape from pally Paultje (M0k) Kessels, I thought it was brill and         converted it into Dutch USA team's Music Assembler. Bass is nice,         original MA drums are awful." (JW)

TITLE: Kung Fu Fighting
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Kung Fu Fighting [from Kung Fu Fighting] ARTIST: Carl DouglasCOMMENT: "This is what you get when you have to make a tune on a party (Vision         2002) in a hurry without a keyboard! Exile/Anubis made a pic of a toy         hamster singing this song. (one of the compo prizes). That's why I         made this. I changed the text which is in the beginning of this tune         at $1000 into: please don't rip this music etc. But yeah! those guys         of the HVSC crew want every SID ever made in the HVSC. So that's why         it's in here! Oh sigh!" (JW)

TITLE: Lady (Hear Me Tonight)
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Lady ARTIST: ModjoCOMMENT: "Modjo made a cover of Chic's Soup For One from 1982. Composers were         Bernard Edwards and Nile Rodgers. Modjo's version is much faster.         Something which you see more lately in covers. This music was made for         D-Pac, he made a textro to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the 64!         It was released on 19th of October 2002 at the special edition of the         Dutch HCC computer show. As you can hear this sound uses a 2 tracks         snare which was taken from Tim Follin's Qix. Hope U like it!" (JW)

TITLE: Linko
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "This game was a conversion of a popular word game on tv in Holland         and even was sometime in Germany on the telly in which you get one         letter of the 5 or 6 and have to guess which word it is, roughly said.         It's been on the Dutch telly for years and years now, and still is         very popular. Game was coded by pally Roland Hermans. And the music         consists of several covers." (JW)(#1)  TITLE: Ritmo de la Noche ARTIST: MysticCOMMENT: "This is the title theme and means in English: Rhythm of the night.         Mystic's version was based on: I go to Rio from Peter Allen and Ritmo         de la Noche by Chocolate. It contains 5 tracks: 3 normal and 2         separate digi tracks consisting of a drum track and some several         chords track. Was first made with Protracker on my old and trusty         Amiga 500." (JW)(#2)COMMENT: "The row of notes (not the bass or lead) is borrowed from a music I         heard in the heroic cartoon series Prince Valiant and is used as high         score music. It consists again a bass from Tim Follin's Psycho Pigs         UXB tune #1. Lead is again of Jeroen Tel's Myth tune #3 this time         without filter. Of course the old trick is used to divide the notes         over 2 tracks." (JW)(#3)  TITLE: I Promised Myself (1:01-1:47) ARTIST: Nick KamenCOMMENT: "This is the ingame music and consists of 3 parts: The first I wrote         myself, and the 3rd is also self made, hear that super fast bass!         The second part is a cover, mentioned above." (JW)(#4)  TITLE: Hazard ARTIST: Richard MarxCOMMENT: "This is the game over tune. Also first use of slide effects         (portamento) in my music to give that extra edge." (JW)

TITLE: Lullaby
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "Called sleeping song because Roland thought it was a song from which         you get very sleepy. The chords are taken from the beginning of the         music of a Dutch USA team demo called Nemesis, I made use of some         sawtooth presets to get that Galway feel. Bassline is simply using a C         note and the C note an octave higher. Made in Music Assembler which         was shortened by pally Roland Hermans, so it only occupies memory from         $1000-$12EF on the C64 which is 3 blocks (less than 1 K!). Neil         Baldwin's Music Demo Number One was an example for me, using 2 tracks         for lead when the bass is suspended. The nicest thing of the C64 SID         chip is that you can create a warm analogue sound." (JW)

TITLE: Masterpiece
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "An experimental piece. This was the least bad version. Composed on         piano and by voice." (JW)

TITLE: Merlin's Dream
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: titlemusic v2 [from the Amiga game Double Dragon III] (2:48-3:57) ARTIST: Andrew Barnabas (Night-Shade of Ecstasy)COMMENT: "This is my Mekka Symposium 2001 SID competition entry. It finished         11th from the 29 and got 32 votes. Too bad there is no independent         jury on the Mekka party so if you know a lot of people who will vote         for you, you will finish 1st. The first part (from 0:00 to 0:45) was         made back in '92. The rest was made in 2 weeks in 2001. At the party         SIDs are played up to 4 minutes. So I had to stop at the end of the         4th minute. Since this msx contains a sample beat it must be played on         an old SID, as was done on the party. You had to mention on the entry         sheet which SID they had to use. Too bad the music was played too soft         on the party (held during Easter). The zax might be a bit too         long-winded. The DD III part was converted from an Amiga MOD" (JW)         The Double Dragon III music is better known by its real name of Water         II and was one of the tracks on Andrew Barnabas' CD.

TITLE: Merlin's Dream V2
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "Look at text enclosed with Merlin's Dream. Music is the same but the         sample beat was removed and replaced by normal C64 drums which were         attached to the bass notes. This tune was used in diskmag         Arachnophobia #21." (JW)

TITLE: MK II
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "Was used in the Spanish SF adventure MK II. Music is played when the         awesome intro pic is shown which makes it sound even better! Again the         Matt Gray minimalistic style was used but I added some of my own ideas         as well as you can hear." (JW)

TITLE: More Than Meets
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Eye ARTIST: <?>COMMENT: "Another conversion for a JSL picture for Vision 2003. Original was         from 1988 and used some bad presets. Bass and fluty presets were made         by Roland H. and lead is again from Robocop. This tune was always one         of my favourites and can be found in the intro of the game Eye." (JW)

TITLE: Pang Remix
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven
STILENTRY: TITLE: Puff, The Magic Dragon ARTIST: Peter, Paul & MaryCOMMENT: "Original music used terrible presets! I also added some chords, which         turned out quite nicely I think. Lead preset is same as bass one. This         is the preset I've used most." (JW)

TITLE: Parasol Stars Boss
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Parasol Stars Boss [from the PC Engine game] ARTIST: Turbo Mira, YasukoCOMMENT: "This is like the Ingame tune a conversion of an Amiga Octamed file I         found on the net. Same presets used as in the Ingame tune. Only a         slide effect had to be inserted which wasn't in the other Parasol         Stars tunes. This zax sounds a bit like the old Latin Lambada tune by         Kaoma from 1987. Of course this tune was played during the game after         the normal levels when the big boss appeared" (JW)

TITLE: Parasol Stars High Score
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Parasol Stars High Score [from the PC Engine game] ARTIST: Turbo Mira, YasukoCOMMENT: "This is like the Ingame tune a conversion of an Amiga Octamed file I         found on the net. Same presets used as in the Ingame tune. The         original Amiga tune had 4 tracks but the extra track was used as an         echo of the lead track so the essence of the tune is in this SID."(JW)

TITLE: Parasol Stars Ingame
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Parasol Stars ingame [from the PC Engine game] ARTIST: Turbo Mira, YasukoCOMMENT: "This is a conversion of an Amiga Octamed file I found on the net. It         was my entry for the Vision party 2001. It was the best music but         since there were not enough entries, all entries were put into 1         competition. It finished 4th. All presets were done by buddy Roland         Hermans which very much sound like the Amiga ones. Great job! I always         wanted to convert this tune and fortunately I found the Med files         which saved me from very much work. 11 presets were used among a         filter bass preset. TITLE: Rolfie Title Remix
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: COMMENT: "This is a remix of the title theme I made for a children's cd rom I         am making together with some pallies of mine. The cd rom is called         "Rolfie Op Wereldreis" which is translated: "Rolfie On A World Trip"         and is about a cat which travels around the world visiting 10         countries from which England and America are divided into 2 pages. So         in total there are 12 different country drawings, a title page, a         credits page and and end page. With every page there comes an         appropriate, spheric music plus lyrics about what can be seen in the         drawings. All the sight seeing objects can be seen in a picture of         each country. For instance in Egypt you can see: some pyramids, a         sphinx, the Nile, a palm tree, some background items and Rolfie the         cat on a camel. When you click on an object it starts to animate and a         WAV-file begins to play making e.g. a camel sound and telling a story         about e.g. a camel. This title tune is apart from the melody altered         heavily to let it sound ok on the C64. This is the first tune I made         since 1992 which was spread, so you can call it a sort of test tune.         And this is also the first tune made for mainly Poland based group         Axelerate which has died in the beginning of 2001. All presets are the         same as in Linko music except before every bass sound (from 0:15),         there is a kick drum sound added. Idea for 3 track chords in beginning         is from Reyn Ouwehand's Deadlock (brilliant title tune). Wind sound         was added, as always if something needs to be added, it was done by         pally Roland 'Neo' Hermans. Hope U like it!" (JW)

TITLE: Turrican III Level 3
AUTHOR: Joachim Wijnhoven (Yogibear)
STILENTRY: TITLE: Air Combat (level 3) [from the Amiga game Turrican III] ARTIST: Chris HülsbeckCOMMENT: "Another MIDI file conversion taken from the Video Game Music Archive         (www.vgmusic.com). It was first intended to be a high score music for         a shoot'em up from Protovision, but they didn't want covers in their         games. Roland and I first put the filter on the arpeggios like Robocop         title but in most cases it is best to put it on the bass like we did         in this tune. I think this is one of the best basslines I ever heard.         It's pretty complex! Chris is/was probably the best German computer         zax composer ever. I think! The arpeggios are not chords they consist         of 2 notes. Lead is from Dunn's Robocop title, rest by Roland. Hope U         like it!" (JW)
